blocks.html: Robinsons Place Ilocos treats its patrons to exciting weekends with their Kapamilya Celebrity favorites as it celebrates the opening of its expansion mall. Mark your calendars and prepare your camera phones and snapchats for the fun-filled grand opening activities of Robinsons Place Ilocos on July 14, 2016. Start your day beautiful as Miss Philippines Earth 2016 Imelda Bautista Schweighart entertains guests at the mall’s grand opening event. The Filipino-German model turned beauty queen will amaze the crowd with her charm and endearing vocals. She will also be joined by one of the sought-after leading man and The Story of Us lead actor, Xian Lim. This multifaceted Chinese-Filipino actor will serenade his Ilocano fans at Robisnosn Place Ilocos (expansion) activity area at 3 PM. Special activities just keep on coming as teen cutie Nash delivers fascinating song and dance numbers on July 17, 4 PM at Robinsons Place Ilocos (expansion) activity area. Nash Aguas, currently paired with the charming Alexa Ilacad, was part of Luv U, a hit Filipino teen series every Sunday and Bagito a drama series aired every afternoon. He is also part of the Gimme 5 boyband together with other cutie friends- Joaquin Lucas Miguel Saavedra Reyes, John Emmanuel Lizondra Bermundo, Grae Fernandez and Brace Henry Arquiza. Come July 23, 4 PM, Chinito fans will definitely swoon over the dashing Enchong Dee as he sings the latest songs from his album, EDM (Enchong Dee Moves) under Star Music. Get to know his latest hits- Telenobela, ‘Di Ko Alam, Tambalang OMG, Sa Huli, Hanggang Dito Na Lang, Crush, Hopia, and Tara Pagpawisan. Make your Robinsons Place Ilocos visit even more memorable by taking your best selfies and groufies with larger than life Robinsons Malls mug, high chair and photo frame located in the different photo corners at the mall expansion. To add color to the celebration, drum beaters and festival performers shall parade around the mall. What’s more, shoppers also get the chance to win delightful prizes in exchange of every P1,500.00 single-receipt purchase. Promo duration is from July 14-17.
